en.headline: Temperatures drop under northeast monsoon as Hong Kong turns cooler
en.dek: The Observatory said morning readings were generally three to four degrees lower than yesterday, with urban lows around 18 degrees tonight and further falls expected tomorrow.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said a strong northeast monsoon was affecting the coast of Guangdong, with a cloud band covering southern China. Local temperatures this morning were generally three to four degrees lower than the previous day.

Today is expected to be mainly cloudy with one or two light rain patches and appreciably cooler. The daytime maximum will be about 22 degrees, with urban temperatures falling to a minimum of about 18 degrees around midnight and a couple of degrees lower in the New Territories. Moderate to fresh northerly winds will blow, occasionally strong offshore and on high ground.

The Observatory said tomorrow would bring further cooling, with urban minimums around 15 degrees and lower readings in the New Territories. It urged the public, especially those outdoors, to note the change, keep warm, and take care of the elderly and those with chronic conditions.

zh.headline: 東北季候風影響下香港氣溫下降天氣轉涼
zh.dek: 天文台指今早各區氣溫普遍較昨日低三至四度，晚上市區最低約18度，明日進一步下降。
body: 香港天文台表示，一股強烈東北季候風正影響廣東沿岸，同時一道雲帶覆蓋華南。本港今早多處地區氣溫較昨日低三至四度左右。
今日大致多雲，有一兩陣微雨，天氣顯著轉涼。日間最高氣溫約22度，晚上市區氣溫下降至午夜最低約18度，新界再低兩三度。吹和緩至清勁偏北風，離岸及高地間中吹強風。
天文台展望明日有幾陣雨，氣溫進一步下降至市區最低約15度，新界再低兩三度。市民特別是戶外活動人士請留意天氣變化，注意保暖，並關顧長者及慢性病患者。
